agent_explanation: Actuated control with detector_fail on W (t=636 dur 210) causes EW green that began at ~608 to be held indefinitely. EW green is still active at 636, 674, 700 and 804. Max_green is 66s so it should have ended by ~674, but it persists for ~196s to the end. With EW holding green, NS (N,S) remains red with growing queues and wait accumulates to 201s >200 at step 804. Removing the single detector_fail restores normal cycling (max_green/recall enforced) and the same 804-step run has no violation, confirming the detector_fail-actuated interaction as cause.
